title: Sweet Korean Vegan Wrap
description: A flavorful vegan wrap filled with spicy Korean-inspired sweet potato and earthy goodness. Prepare to delight your taste buds with this delicious and easy-to-make recipe.
instructions: Poke the sweet potatoes with a fork a few times and roast for 45 minutes, or until tender.
In a pan, sauté the sliced mushrooms with minced garlic over medium heat until they're tender and fragrant.
Add the Korean chili flakes and stir-fry for another minute.
Once the sweet potatoes are done, let them cool slightly, then slice them into thin wedges.
Assemble the wraps by spreading a layer of the mushroom mixture on the wrap, followed by some roasted sweet potato wedges.
Add any additional toppings of your choice, such as sliced green onions or pickled ginger.
